findings.criterion: 7 and cross-cutting data integrity — idempotent Super Admin tenant creation
findings.issue: definePlatformRoute ignores Idempotency-Key, while the Platform create form has neither a submission key nor an in-flight guard. Two rapid submissions, or a retry after a committed response is lost, execute provisionTenant twice; its generated-slug collision path creates a second tenant under a random suffix.
findings.consequence: One intended Super Admin action can create two live properties, owner relationships, starter inventories, policies, and audit histories.
findings.correction: Add actor-scoped platform idempotency that hashes method, URL, and parsed body and replays the original response; bind the form to a payload-scoped key and block duplicate in-flight submission. Add a real-route same-key/lost-response test proving exactly one tenant and associated records and replay of the original 201.

findings.criterion: 6 and cross-cutting data integrity — recoverable local-auth person creation
findings.issue: Local addPerson returns the only generated temporary password in the first response, but replay storage serializes temporaryPassword as null. After a committed request whose response is lost, the retry returns 201 without a credential and People reports an invitation even though local auth created no invitation; local auth has no forgot/reset recovery path.
findings.consequence: The membership exists but neither the administrator nor the person has a usable password or recovery path.
findings.correction: Keep credentials out of replay storage, but use a recoverable setup/invitation flow or add authenticated credential setup/reset with an explicit replay outcome. Add a lost-response UI/API test through successful first sign-in.

findings.criterion: 7 and cross-cutting data integrity — idempotent cross-property person creation
findings.issue: POST /v1/platform/tenants/:slug/members uses definePlatformRoute, so it ignores the stable key People supplies. An exact retry reaches direct addPerson again and returns already_member; for a newly created local account the only temporary password was in the lost response. The rendered test mocks the endpoint and proves only that a key argument was supplied.
findings.consequence: A required Super Admin cross-property write can report failure after success and leave the new person unable to sign in.
findings.correction: Apply tenant-scoped replay handling to the platform member endpoint and return a recoverable onboarding result. Add a same-key real-route retry test asserting one account, membership, and audit event plus usable setup/sign-in.

findings.criterion: 1 — resident generates and shares a usable tamper-protected two-hour pass
findings.issue: The rendered flow starts from a fabricated token, mounts GuestPass directly instead of entering /pass through AppProvider/App, replaces the camera, and mocks lookup/redeem. Separate API tests cover expiry, HMAC, and stored verify_code mismatch, but no recorded run joins a server-generated pass to the actual Resident Share control, public bootstrap, decoded QR, and real gate validation.
findings.consequence: The complete resident-generate to share to guest-open to scan to real gate-validation path remains unverified in context.
findings.correction: Issue a live pass, invoke the real Share control, open its fragment URL through /pass at a mobile viewport, decode the QR, and perform real lookup/redeem. Assert exact token identity, two-hour unused expiry, HMAC rejection, and valid-HMAC/stored-verify_code mismatch rejection in that joined run.

findings.criterion: 3 and 4 — camera plate scanning during check-in and check-out
findings.issue: Rendered tests replace LiveCamera with an already-decoded plate button. No recorded run executes getUserMedia, the shipped ONNX loader/decoder, a camera fixture, and responsive browser behavior; the real-camera script covers check-in only.
findings.consequence: Actual camera acquisition and plate decoding remain unverified in the shipped stack for both check-in and check-out.
findings.correction: Run and record the 390x844 fake-camera check-in story with the real model and .y4m fixture; add and run a checkout equivalent. Assert the filled plate, checkout match request/result, stopped camera tracks, browser/model/fixture versions, and a clean console.

findings.criterion: 6 and 7 — complete Admin CRUD and Super Admin operations across properties
findings.issue: Gate-backed rendered tests mock every API and complete CRUD only for a unit; person and site/slot coverage is partial, and Super Admin coverage is one mocked person POST. The real browser CRUD script has no recorded run, is desktop-only, and omits full person CRUD, representative second-property operations, and real regular-admin cross-property denial.
findings.consequence: Complete person/building/unit/slot administration, persisted cross-property operations, authorization boundaries, and narrow-screen usability remain unverified in context.
findings.correction: Run and record full create/read/edit/delete-or-retire paths through the real routed UI/API at a narrow viewport. Perform representative all-entity writes in a second property as Super Admin, assert persistence, and prove regular-admin server denial for cross-property attempts.
